variation_policy: No expansion by channel, language, identity, app name or numeric substitution. Combinatorial prefixes are reported explicitly. Each continuation starts from inherited state and changes authorization, intent, quantity, permission, or selection.
limitations: English only; does not establish Spanish parity.
Synthetic planner contexts do not establish native or transport behavior.
Visible equivalence needs independent judge hashes; no reviews are generated here.

bases.purpose: A complete one-off request queues once; acknowledgement is not new authorization.
Explicit strictness survives preparation and duplicate confirmation.
A complete duration and recurrence do not invent a start.
Immediate intent and one-off recurrence still require duration.
A yes cannot invent whether protection repeats.
Collect start, duration and recurrence separately without asking for another app list.
Duration answered before start is retained while start remains missing.
A recurrence answer out of question order must not fabricate duration.
A subminimum immediate duration is rejected rather than silently clamped.
An above-maximum immediate duration needs a correction before action.
Now is not a recurring local clock; daily protection requires a time and horizon.
Weekend recurrence preserves Saturday/Sunday while replacing invalid now.
Scheduled hard mode stays unsupported until the user explicitly chooses normal protection.
A hard daily limit cannot silently lose the requested strictness.
Daily limit starts now by capability contract but needs an explicit allowance.
A daily allowance cannot discard a requested future start or expiry; each unsupported constraint needs explicit adjustment.
A recurring window must not inherit an implicit seven-day expiry.
An unsupported horizon is corrected explicitly rather than truncated.
An overnight interval keeps its next-day end and native weekday mapping.
Nonadjacent weekly days remain a set rather than a contiguous interval.
An explicit end and incompatible duration are not averaged or guessed.
A one-off future time cannot become an immediate or repeating block without consent.
Tomorrow is preserved until an explicit correction makes the immediate request actionable.
Saying the app is open does not substitute for a trusted device heartbeat.
The same authorized facts survive denied permission and a later real grant.
Describing apps does not create a native Screen Time selection.
Permission and native selection are independent prerequisites with ordered recovery.
Presence, permission and selection arrive separately while a recurring plan remains intact.
A duration correction cannot fill an unrelated missing recurrence slot.
An end correction across midnight recalculates duration from the explicit start.
Moving the start preserves an explicitly requested end and changes duration.
Moving a start preserves a user-supplied duration and recomputes its derived end.
Rejecting daily recurrence also withdraws its horizon until the replacement is specified.
Rejecting a duration removes it; a confirmation cannot restore the rejected quantity.
Rejecting the start removes a derived end, while duration and recurrence survive.
A stated goal and complete facts remain advice until an explicit opt-in.
A privacy question is conversational; only a later explicit selected-app request acts.
An unsupported exception-list request cannot masquerade as broad blocking.
A previous failed block is an observation, distinct from a new authorized instruction.
A cancellation closes old authorization; a fresh request starts with its own missing fields.
